purpose: Audit whether the final pre-outcome GloBI route contains enough species-rank, georeferenced and repeated source-programme support to justify a later semantic network audit. This gate computes support only and never computes turnover, distance-dissimilarity association, rewiring, phylogenetic signal or any biological response.

study_source_rule.reason: GloBI documents dataset namespaces as the identity of indexed source datasets. No citation-level or observation-level field may be substituted after support is seen.

system_rule.interaction_name_role: interactionTypeName is retained for semantic adjudication but does not define a second independent system when interactionTypeId is shared
system_rule.reason: source/target direction is part of the archived relation claim; support cannot be rescued by swapping focal and partner roles.

species_rank_rule.include: both interpreted species-name fields must be non-empty

spatial_support_proxy.role: support proxy only; not yet accepted as a biological network
spatial_support_proxy.site_coordinates: exact parsed decimalLatitude and decimalLongitude; no rounding, clustering or grid aggregation
spatial_support_proxy.time_stratum: first four-digit year parsed from eventDate
spatial_support_proxy.stratum: exact latitude x exact longitude x year within sourceNamespace x interactionTypeId
spatial_support_proxy.semantic_firewall: Passing site-year support does not establish that a stratum is a replicated ecological network. Every passing sourceNamespace must later pass a source-semantic audit that excludes opportunistic occurrence/specimen aggregations before any turnover response is computed.

qualification.repeated_focal_definition: same sourceTaxonSpeciesName occurs in at least two distinct valid site-year strata within the same sourceNamespace x interactionTypeId system
qualification.joint_system_pass: all four frozen requirements above must pass
qualification.independence_rule: sourceNamespace is the independence cluster for the source gate; multiple interaction types within one namespace do not count as multiple independent programmes toward the >=12 requirement

allowed_result_payload: aggregate support counts by sourceNamespace x interactionTypeId
next_gate_if_pass: Freeze and execute a source-semantic network audit for every qualifying sourceNamespace, requiring evidence that repeated location/time strata represent comparable ecological interaction sampling rather than opportunistic occurrence/specimen aggregation. Freeze relation-direction and interaction-family semantics before any turnover response.
next_gate_if_hold: Stop the primary joint GloBI interaction route. The finite-family rule forbids a third primary interaction source.

transport_policy.rule: Transient transport failures are retried without changing source, file, projected columns, support thresholds, or biological rules. A biological support HOLD is returned only after the support query completes.

next_gate_if_persistent_transport_hold: Stop the primary joint GloBI interaction route after the frozen transport retry budget is exhausted. The finite-family rule forbids a third primary interaction source.
